name: Marilith

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The marilith makes six Pact Blade attacks and uses Constrict.

actions.name: Pact Blade
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Ne- crotic damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.text: Strength Saving Throw: DC 17, one Medium or smaller creature the marilith can see within 5 feet.

actions.name: Failure
actions.text: 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends. Bonus Actions Teleport (Recharge 5–6). The marilith teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.text: If the marilith dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points some- where in the Abyss.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The marilith has Advantage on sav- ing throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Reactive
traits.text: The marilith can take one Reaction on every turn of combat.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.text: Trigger: The marilith is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The marilith adds 5 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss. Medusa Medusa
